question:
Two springs $S_1$ and $S_2$ of force constants $k_1$ and $k_2$ respectively, are stretched by the same force. It is found that more work is done on spring $S_1$ than on spring $S_2$.

Statement I: If stretched by the same amount, the work done on $S_1$ will be more than that on $S_2$.

Statement II: $k_1 < k_2$.

options.text: Statement I and Statement II are both true
Statement I is true, Statement II is false
Statement I is false, Statement II is true
Statement I and Statement II are both false

solution:
Same force $F$: extension $x = F/k$, so $W = \dfrac{1}{2}kx^2 = \dfrac{F^2}{2k}$. More work on $S_1$ means $k_1 < k_2$. Statement II is true.

Same extension $x$: $W = \dfrac{1}{2}kx^2$, so the stiffer spring $S_2$ needs more work. Statement I is false.
